description: This Java class represents a job responsible for purging a specific job entity from the system. It extends an abstract job class and implements methods to execute the purge, check validity, manage state transitions, and determine priority.

classes.name: PurgeJob
classes.description: A job class that handles the removal of a specified job sandbox entity and its related data in the system.

methods.name: PurgeJob
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the job with a specific job value entity, setting its ID and name.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the purge job by verifying the queue state and then removing the job using JobUtil.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the job is valid, specifically if it is in the CREATED state.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Handles dequeuing logic, ensuring the job is in the QUEUED state before proceeding.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level of the job, which is LOW.
